title: Composer ImageVersion now indicates dev mode support
summary: The `ImageVersion` schema in Cloud Composer now includes a `devModeSupported` boolean property. This new field indicates whether a specific image version can be used to create environments in `DEVELOPMENT` mode.
details: Developers can now check the `schemas.ImageVersion.properties.devModeSupported` field to programmatically determine if an image version supports the `DEVELOPMENT` mode for environment creation. This provides clearer insight into image capabilities when selecting versions for new Composer environments.
